name: pl.brightinventions.slf4android.handler.notifydeveloper.Slf4AndroidLogFileProvider
description: Bright Inventions' SLF4Android Notify Developer handler uses this Provider when an error report email includes log files. It lets the email app read those files through temporary content links.
disableEffect: Error report emails can still open, but their log attachments are omitted; ordinary app features are unaffected.
